title: Coffee-shop homepage
brief: Build a single-file homepage for Juniper Coffee, a neighborhood coffee shop. Use forest green (#23483C), cream (#FFF7E6), and warm orange (#C76535). Include the shop name, a short introduction, a menu with Espresso ($3), Latte ($5), and Filter coffee ($4), and a visit section with the address 42 Cedar Lane and opening hours Daily 7am–4pm. Make it usable on desktop and mobile. Deliver a self-contained HTML file. This is a local homepage preview; do not deploy or add a contact form.
reviewCriteria: Does the page feel like a distinct neighborhood coffee shop?
Are the requested colors, prices, and opening hours correct?
Can a visitor find the menu and visit details quickly on desktop and mobile?
Which result would you give to the user, and why?
scope: First local fixture only. Text checks do not prove visual quality, factual completeness, a working contact form, three pages, or deployment.
